newsitem.title: USA: McDonald's to boost ads for Big Mac deal-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: McDonald's to boost ads for Big Mac deal-WSJ.

text.p: McDonald's Corp plans to increase advertising for its 55-cent sandwich specials to clarify the promotion and to try to beef up sales, the Wall Street Journal said.
In Tuesday's electronic edition, the Journal said the restaurant chain told franchisees that new in-store signs and counter cards are being shipped to clarify the special pricing.

For the past month, McDonald's has been selling its Big Mac sandwiches at 55 cents when ordered with French fries and a drink. Franchisees have criticized the promotion, saying customers are confused about how the promotion works.
The second launch of the special pricing kicks off Friday, when McDonald's Quarter Pounder with Cheese hamburgers will be sold for 55 cents when ordered with fries and a drink.
